description.text: Program Objective Chinese language and culture program will provide non-native Chinese speakers with the Chinese language knowledge and skills practice. The program objective is to cultivate the practical masters in Chinese language and culture who will speak fluent Chinese and be well equipped with Chinese cultures and the ability of intercultural communication in Chinese language. During their studying andtraining, students will improve their Chinese language abilities in listening, speaking, reading, writing and translating. Students are able to speak fluent Chinese, write normative articles in Chinese written language, and understand some Chinese history and cultures. Main Course Chinese Pinyin,ComprehensiveChinese, Chinese Listening, Chinese Speaking, Chinese Reading and Writing, Practical Communication Skills, HSK Tutorial, Practical Writing, Business Chinese, Chinese News Broadcast, Chinese Newspapers and Periodicals Reading, Chinese Popular Culture. Study Duration 6 months and above.

duration.text: The Chinese Language and Culture at Shandong Jiaotong University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/per year ￥ 12000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized

requirements.text: 1. Observe the law and regulations of People's Republic of China and all regulations of the university 2. Be in good health 3. Under 55 of age; 4. With reliable financial support and custody.
